components.name: Workbench Header
components.description: Compact product chrome with the original three-circle Agent Connect mark.
components.html: Agent ConnectConnect agents to the tools people already use.DocsExamples
components.css: .ds-header { display:flex; min-height:72px; align-items:center; gap:24px; padding:0 30px; border-bottom:1px solid #dde1e8; background:#fff; color:#09172b; font-family:'Figtree Variable',Figtree,sans-serif; } .ds-wordmark { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:16px; color:inherit; text-decoration:none; } .ds-wordmark strong { font-size:18px; letter-spacing:-.02em; } .ds-mark { display:inline-flex; width:66px; align-items:center; } .ds-mark i { width:23px; height:23px; border-radius:50%; box-shadow:inset 0 -2px 4px rgb(9 23 43 / 12%); } .ds-mark i:nth-child(1) { background:#f46864; } .ds-mark i:nth-child(2) { margin-left:-7px; background:#18a6b8; } .ds-mark i:nth-child(3) { margin-left:-7px; background:#7464f2; } .ds-tagline { padding-left:24px; border-left:1px solid #dde1e8; color:#4d5667; font-size:14px; } .ds-links { display:flex; gap:24px; margin-left:auto; } .ds-links a { color:#263247; font-size:13px; text-decoration:none; } .ds-links a:hover { color:#417af4; } .ds-header a:focus-visible { outline:3px solid rgb(65 122 244 / 42%); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Simulated Demo Action
components.description: The explicitly simulated, no-account entry path.
components.html: <button class="ds-demo-button"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m9 7 8 5-8 5V7Z"/></svg>Try the demo</button>
components.css: .ds-demo-button { display:flex; width:100%; min-height:45px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:10px; border:0; border-radius:7px; padding:0 18px; color:#fff; background:#c94b48; box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgb(244 104 100 / 20%); font:700 13px/1.45 'Figtree Variable',Figtree,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-demo-button svg { width:17px; height:17px; fill:currentColor; } .ds-demo-button:hover { background:#ad3937; } .ds-demo-button:active { background:#9d302f; } .ds-demo-button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid rgb(65 122 244 / 42%); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Gateway Address Field
components.description: The live HTTPS OAuth path with a compact inline arrow action.
components.css: .ds-gateway-label { display:grid; gap:8px; color:#09172b; font:700 12px/1.35 'Figtree Variable',Figtree,sans-serif; } .ds-gateway-field { position:relative; display:block; } .ds-gateway-field input { width:100%; height:46px; padding:0 52px 0 11px; border:1px solid #cbd1db; border-radius:6px; color:#09172b; background:#fff; font:400 13px/1.45 'Figtree Variable',Figtree,sans-serif; } .ds-gateway-field button { position:absolute; top:1px; right:1px; display:grid; width:44px; height:44px; place-items:center; border:0; border-radius:7px; color:#344054; background:transparent; cursor:pointer; } .ds-gateway-field button:hover { background:#eef0fb; } .ds-gateway-field svg { width:18px; height:18px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.8; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; } .ds-gateway-field input:focus-visible,.ds-gateway-field button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid rgb(65 122 244 / 42%); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Scenario Selector
components.description: A compact application choice with a slim active rule.
components.css: .ds-scenario { position:relative; display:grid; width:204px; min-height:84px; grid-template-columns:27px 1fr; gap:10px; padding:16px 12px; border:0; border-radius:8px; color:#09172b; background:#eef3ff; text-align:left; font-family:'Figtree Variable',Figtree,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-scenario::before { position:absolute; inset:0 auto 0 0; width:3px; border-radius:3px; background:#417af4; content:''; } .ds-scenario-icon { width:19px; height:16px; border:2px solid currentColor; border-radius:3px; } .ds-scenario strong { display:block; margin-bottom:5px; font-size:13px; } .ds-scenario small { display:block; color:#586173; font-size:11.5px; line-height:1.42; } .ds-scenario:hover { background:#e7edfb; } .ds-scenario:focus-visible { outline:3px solid rgb(65 122 244 / 42%); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Connected Task Action

components.name: Activity Trace Row
components.description: A compact correlated event record with stable actor identity.
components.css: .ds-trace-row { display:grid; min-height:31px; grid-template-columns:90px 1.5fr 1.8fr 3fr; align-items:center; gap:10px; border-bottom:1px solid #edf0f4; color:#09172b; font:400 11px/1.35 'Figtree Variable',Figtree,sans-serif; } .ds-trace-row time { color:#697284; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-actor { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; } .ds-actor i { width:18px; height:18px; border-radius:50%; background:#18a6b8; } .ds-trace-row code { overflow:hidden; color:#5f6878; font:400 11px/1.4 'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; }

components.name: Tool Flight
components.description: The single transient correlated tool request over the active application.
components.css: .ds-tool-flight { display:inline-flex; gap:8px; padding:8px 11px; border-radius:7px; color:#fff; background:#5948d7; box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgb(78 66 183 / 25%); font:400 11px/1.35 'Figtree Variable',Figtree,sans-serif; transition:background 180ms ease; } .ds-tool-flight:hover { background:#4d3eba; } .ds-tool-flight:focus-visible { outline:3px solid rgb(65 122 244 / 42%); outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview:
Agent Connect Canvas is a bright, product-neutral workbench whose first view is already the working product. A compact header, scenario rail, independently branded application, two honest entry paths, and correlated activity trace make the handoff visible without a marketing hero or decorative architecture prelude.

The interface is dense but calm: white and cool-gray surfaces carry most of the screen, thin rules establish structure, and saturated color identifies ownership or state. The deterministic in-browser demo and the live HTTPS OAuth gateway path remain visibly separate. Agent Connect supplies connection controls and evidence; each third-party application retains its own name, chrome, palette, content model, and tools.
keyCharacteristics: Open Workbench in the first viewport; working proof is the lead.
Independent third-party application ownership inside neutral Agent Connect chrome.
Explicit simulated-demo and live-OAuth entry paths.
Original overlapping three-circle Agent Connect mark in coral, teal, and periwinkle.
Compact Figtree UI with IBM Plex Mono reserved for event evidence.
Thin dividers, 12px major surfaces, and mostly 7px controls.
One authored inline-SVG action-icon family with rounded strokes and simple geometry.
Darker action fills preserve contrast while actor colors remain available as identity signals.

rules.name: The Actor Color Rule
rules.body: Coral means application, teal means gateway, and periwinkle means user-owned agent in Agent Connect-owned explanations and traces. Embedded apps may use their own palettes because they are separate products.

rules.name: The Contrast Fill Rule
rules.body: Identity swatches may stay vivid, but controls with white text use the implemented darker coral, teal, periwinkle, or ink fills.

rules.name: The Neutral Majority Rule
rules.body: White and cool gray occupy most of every viewport. Color clarifies ownership and state; it does not become ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Evidence Voice Rule
rules.body: Prose explains in Figtree; event details prove in IBM Plex Mono. Do not use monospace as decorative tech styling.

rules.name: The Compact Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from weight, grouping, and ownership chrome rather than oversized type. This surface has no display-scale marketing headline.

rules.name: The Working-First Rule
rules.body: Do not place a marketing hero, runtime-card intake, or explanatory animation ahead of the workbench.

rules.name: The Ownership Layout Rule
rules.body: The application occupies the central working area and keeps its own internal navigation; Agent Connect controls frame it without masquerading as part of that application.

rules.name: The Structural-First Rule
rules.body: Use spacing, dividers, and tonal contrast before shadow. Resting surfaces use one restrained lift, not stacked decorative effects.

rules.name: The Major-and-Control Rule
rules.body: Default to 12px for principal containers and 7px for controls; use another radius only when the implemented component has a distinct functional reason.

dos: Do open on the working product and keep both entry paths visible and honestly labeled.
Do preserve each third-party application's visual ownership and app-native controls.
Do keep the original three-circle mark and the coral/app, teal/gateway, periwinkle/agent mapping in Agent Connect-owned evidence.
Do use Figtree for interface language and IBM Plex Mono only for machine evidence.
Do use darker accessible fills when white text sits on an action or transient status surface.
Do keep the connected task form in normal flow on mobile and maintain clear keyboard focus and touch targets.
donts: Don't restore the runtime-card field, pre-workbench hero micro-flow, or animated setup terminal; the shipped workbench does not promise them.
Don't merge the deterministic simulated demo with the live HTTPS OAuth gateway path.
Don't make Agent Connect chrome look like it owns Northstar, Fieldnotes, or Everyday.
Don't replace the inline SVG action family with emoji, mixed icon libraries, or inconsistent stroke weights.
Don't use gradients, glassmorphism, oversized radii, decorative grid backgrounds, or sci-fi styling.
Don't turn the page into a terminal-first setup guide or a dense enterprise-security dashboard.
